West Bengal Joint Entrance Examinations Board (WBJEEB) has announced the WBJEE Result 2026 on June 18, 2026, at 1:30 PM. Students who have appeared for the entrance exam can check their scores online. The WBJEE Rank Card 2026 has been issued by the Board at 4:00 PM on same day. Candidate will require application number and password for checking result and rank card. WBJEE Result is used to determine eligibility for admission to undergraduate Engineering, Technology, Architecture and Pharmacy courses offered by participating institutes across West Bengal.

WBJEE Result 2026 Out

WBJEE 2026 Result out on 18th June 2026 at 1:30 PM. Candidates who appeared in the entrance examination can now check their scores and ranks on the official website. The result is a reflection of the performance of the candidates in the examination and their eligibility for admission to Engineering, Technology, Architecture and Pharmacy programmes offered by participating institutes across West Bengal.

WBJEE Rank Card 2026 Released

WBJEE Rank Card 2026 released today at 4:00 PM on 18th June 2026. Rank Card is one of the most important documents required for the admission process. It has the candidate’s General Merit Rank (GMR), personal details and examination performance. Candidates are suggested to download and keep multiple copies of rank card as it will be needed during counselling and seat allotment.

WBJEE 2026 Topper List Out

WBJEE Toppers 2026 list announced by wbjeeb on 18 june 2026 along with results declaration. Shaswat Banerjee is declared as the topper among those who have appeared for the WBJEE exam this year. The list includes the names of those students who belong to CBSE, CISCE, and WBCHSE board schools and have performed well in subjects like Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry.

WBJEE 2026 Topper Shaswat Banerjee

The WBJEE 2026 topper name out with the result declaration on 18 June 2026. Shaswat Banerjee has achieved General Merit Rank (GMR) 1 in WBJEE 2026 examination. The topper list contains the best performing candidates on the basis of their scores in Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry. Candidates can check the full merit rankings via the official WBJEE rank card and result portal.

WBJEE Result 2026 Download Link

WBJEE Result 2026 download link has been activated on the official website of WBJEEB. Candidates can verify their results by entering their application number and password at the login portal. Candidates can check their result and rank instantly through the online result facility. Candidates are advised to download the scorecard and keep a copy of the scorecard for future admission related activities.

WBJEE Result 2026 Direct Link

How to Download WBJEE Result 2026?

Candidates can check  WBJEE Result 2026 online by following the below mentioned steps. The process is simple and needs only the login details created at the time of registration.

  1. Open official website of WBJEEB
  2. Click on the WBJEE 2026 Result link
  3. Enter application number & password
  4. Submit details to access the result
  5. Kindly check the rank and score details
  6. Download and print the result for future use

What Details are Mentioned on WBJEE Rank Card 2026?

The WBJEE Rank Card 2026 carries important details about the candidate’s performance in the entrance examination. After downloading it candidates are advised to check all the details carefully.

  • Candidate’s Name
  • Roll Number
  • Application Number
  • Date of Birth
  • Category
  • Gender
  • Total Score
  • Paper-wise Scores
  • General Merit Rank (GMR)
  • Pharmacy Merit Rank (PMR), if applicable

WBJEE Rank Card 2026 PDF Download

The WBJEEB rank card PDF is published online on the official portal of the WBJEEB. Candidates are required to login using their application number and password to access the document. Participation in counselling and admission rounds requires the rank card. Candidates without valid rank card may face problems during seat allotment and document verification process.

WBJEE Merit Rank 2026

General Merit Rank (GMR) is one of the important factors for deciding the admission chances for candidates. It is based on the performance of the candidates in Paper I (Mathematics) and Paper II (Physics and Chemistry). Counselling generally gives more preference to candidates with better ranks and they have more chances to get seats in top institutions.

WBJEE Counselling 2026

WBJEE Counselling 2026 will now start as the result and rank card are released. The eligible candidates will be required to register online and submit their choice of colleges and courses. The seat will be allotted on the basis of merit rank, category, seats availability and choices filled by the candidates during counselling registration.

Stage Description
Registration Online counselling registration
Choice Filling Selection of colleges and courses
Choice Locking Final submission of preferences
Seat Allotment Seats allotted based on rank and choices
Document Verification Verification of required documents
Seat Acceptance Payment of admission/acceptance fee
Reporting Reporting to allotted institute

WBJEE Participating Institutes 2026

Several government colleges, private engineering institutes, universities and self financed institutions accept WBJEE score for admission. These institutions offer undergraduate degree programs in Engineering, Technology, Architecture and Pharmacy. Admission in the participating colleges will be based on their WBJEE ranks and availability of seats as per their counseling preference and merit. Check WBJEE Colleges that accept the score.

Institute Type Examples
Government Engineering Colleges Jadavpur University, Government College of Engineering & Textile Technology
State Universities MAKAUT and affiliated institutes
Private Engineering Colleges Various WBJEE participating private institutions
Pharmacy Colleges Government and private pharmacy colleges in West Bengal

WBJEE 2026 Admission Process

WBJEE 2026 Admission Process WBJEE 2026 admission process is a multi-step process which involves result declaration, download of rank card, registration for counselling, choice filling, seat allotment, document verification and admission confirmation. The candidate has to complete each step within the deadlines. Non-compliance with counselling instructions will invite cancellation of allotted seat.

Admission Stage Details
Result Declaration Release of scores and ranks
Rank Card Download Download rank card from portal
Counselling Registration Register for counselling
Choice Filling Select preferred colleges and courses
Seat Allotment Allocation of seats based on merit
Document Verification Verification of original documents
Admission Confirmation Payment of fees and reporting to institute
